name: ATTIO_VISUAL_CONTRACT
source_of_truth: Current public https://attio.com/ HTML and linked CSS retrieved 2026-10-05; the prior 570x1430 image is only used for inferred ratios.

hero_heading_desktop.source_detail: H1 class and inline size/tracking from current page HTML; class utilities resolve in linked CSS.

hero_heading_mobile.source_detail: Mobile alternate H1 classes text-heading-md and sm:text-heading-lg plus --text-heading-* tokens. The desktop H1 becomes visible at the md breakpoint.

section_heading.source_detail: text-heading-responsive-md + font-medium; responsive rule at min-width 992px.

final_cta_heading.source_detail: Final CTA H2 classes and inline style in the current page HTML.

value.font_feature_settings: Global default resolves to normal; current CSS does not contain ss03. Overline utility enables calt.

body_typography.source_detail: html uses font-sans text-base; linked CSS declares the font and --text-base tokens.

font_files.source_detail: Public @font-face declarations in 002k2pnwynkdl.css. Japanese rendering is not forced into Inter; use a Japanese system/Noto Sans JP stack with comparable weight.

hero_spacing.source_detail: Current hero shell and mobile alternate hero classes. The negative margin supports Attio's scroll-reveal choreography; it is not required for GARAGE LINK.

value.container_gutter_css: 24px below 768px; 56px from 768px unless locally overridden; 58px at lg hero

content_width.source_detail: Container utility rules and actual hero classes; 360 spacing units at 992px equal 1440px.

platform_grid.source_detail: 24-column grid, 1/7 and remaining-column navigation placement, max-w-[896px], pt-22/28/38 and pb-16/18/20 classes.

value.feature_copy_padding_css: px: calc(100% / 24), lg: calc(100% / 18); top: 64px / 80px / 112px at base/lg/xl; bottom: 44px / 56px / 80px
value.product_ui_width: fills the remaining content columns up to the 1440px container cap
value.product_ui_appears: after the hero and before the long feature explanation

feature_copy_to_product_stage.source_detail: First platform article wrapper classes; the UI itself is live HTML, not a marketing screenshot.

value.button_hierarchy: one filled primary action and subdued/outlined secondary action

cta_geometry.source_detail: Header CTA h-9 px-3 rounded-[10px] text-sm; hero/email CTA h-11.5 px-3.5 rounded-xl text-base.

value.surface_hierarchy: background and thin borders lead; near-black type; blue is reserved for semantic accents/links rather than broad decorative surfaces

surface_and_color.source_detail: Light theme internal color tokens in the public CSS resolve through white/black palette tokens.

value.content_sections: mostly square/border-defined; radius is used where the actual control/UI requires it

border_radius.source_detail: rounded-[10px] and --radius-xl:.75rem utilities in the linked CSS.

value.shadow_policy: selective, low-alpha; primary hierarchy is expressed with borders

border_and_shadow.source_detail: Border utility rules, shadow tokens, and max-lg:shadow-attio-2 on the compact platform navigation.

value.position: sticky top:0 wrapper; header itself is a bordered surface inside it
value.background: primary background at 95% opacity, opaque in dark mode

header.source_detail: --site-header-nav-height:52px, sticky wrapper class, and header duration-250 utility.

responsive_structure.source_detail: Unique min-width rules, responsive H1 visibility/classes, and max-lg/lg platform-navigation classes in current HTML/CSS.

value.platform_navigation: sticky below site header; side grid at lg, compact horizontal bar below lg
value.product_ui_stage: not a persistent fixed overlay; product content remains in the document flow
value.fixed_marketing_cta: none observed in current page HTML shell

sticky_and_fixed.source_detail: Position-bearing wrapper and navigation classes; no fixed CTA element in the page shell.

value.reduced_motion: linked CSS has prefers-reduced-motion:reduce overrides; avoid adding motion that cannot be disabled

transitions_and_motion.source_detail: Tailwind transition tokens, button component CSS, hero's reveal-state markup, and reduced-motion media queries.

copy_to_visible_product_area_fraction.unit: hero copy height / first visible product height

first_product_ui_top_fraction.unit: viewport height; appears in the 570x1430 image

570_capture_ratios_non_gating.source_detail: Approximate relative ranges only. The screenshot is not available as a local image artifact; these values are descriptive and are not acceptance gates or a basis for structural decisions.

transplant: short hero followed immediately by real product UI
responsive structure driven by explicit breakpoints
small restrained motion with reduced-motion support
do_not_copy: exact English font glyph shapes for Japanese
decorative gradients, broad brand color panels, or unnecessary sticky choreography

acceptance_tolerance.discrete_properties: exact structural match to the selected contract values
